name: ghidra
description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
one_liner: A free, professional-grade toolkit for taking apart compiled software to see exactly how it works, built by the NSA for security analysts.
buyer: A security researcher or malware analyst at a cybersecurity firm who needs to reverse-engineer suspicious binaries.
business_use_cases: A security consultancy uses it to reverse-engineer client malware samples as part of paid incident-response engagements.
A vulnerability-research firm builds custom Ghidra scripts and sells findings or bug bounties derived from using it.
A firmware/IoT security auditor uses it to analyze device firmware for clients' product security certifications.

money_ideas.idea: Sell reverse-engineering and security-audit consulting services built on top of it
Build and sell premium Ghidra plugins or scripts for specific niches such as firmware or malware-family analysis

steal_this: Not a weekend product play. It's a mature, free, decade-old tool from a government agency; the money is in the scarce expertise and services built around it, not in wrapping the tool itself.
